{{Top|leg}}
A '''rantweed cluster''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]].<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> rantweed clusters were one of various exotic foodstuffs loaded onboard a [[Seltiss-2 caravel|Hutt caravel]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during a stopover above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]],<ref name="Scourge" /> for transport to Popara's [[Yacht/Legends|space yacht]] ''[[Imru Ootmian]]''.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
